reviews.author: Soumen Bhattacharjee
reviews.text:
If you are going towards nandi hills, you should try this place. Specially the evening ambience is really good.

Ambience - I will give 5/5. It has a very good ambience specially in evening seating on the terrace.

Food variety - They have lot of options to choose from. 5/5

Food tastes -Taste for some items are really good and few are not good. Fish tikka is good. 4/5

Service - Service was bit slow but not bad. 4/5

Price - I will rate 5/5. Decent pricing.

It's a good place to go with friends or family. Toilet is not well maintained. Smell very bad.

Happy dining foodie.

reviews.author: 葉又嘉
reviews.text:
I went on the trip from south Bangalore to Nandi hills. On our way back from Nandi hill, this restaurant caught our attention. It’s next to the highway. So we stopped for Food before heading back to Bangalore around 4:30pm.

The food was really nice! We ordered butter Chicken and garlic Naan! With lime soda.
The food was really awesome. The atmosphere was nice! Gives an American country bar vibe! Great place for family/ friends gathering! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
However the  cleanness needs to improve 😅.
I can understand that people will need to use the toilet since is next to the highway. So the usage of the toilet will be more frequent here. There are flies flying around specially near to the toilet/ kitchen entrance. There are food crumbs on the floor near the entrance. And while I was sitting at my table, there were a lot of mosquitoes biting me that we have to finish my meal fast to get out of the restaurant.
Hopefully the owner can schedule the toilet cleaning more frequently.

Despite the cleanness needs to improve. I still recommend this place because of the great food and friendly staff!!!!!

reviews.author: Dr.Chaithanya H K
reviews.text:
One spot where we doesn't miss at Friday nighout to airport bck home.
Their parathas are really good and tempting. They serve wide types of parathas, freshly made and served hot with butter, curd and achar.

All time favorites is paneer paratha.
The service is good. But price is quite high, but due to highway it's more.
The chaas is also very good and is done according to our needs.

Chilling outdoor is best experience at night is really good with ur frnds and family. They do have a restroom, quite neatly maintained.

reviews.author: Ansh Paliwal
reviews.text:
A place with good ambience and location, this place has a good range of north indian food with enough parking and seats. Garlic naan is a must, I tried it today and I'm definitely going to order it again the next time. The reason I cut a star is due to slow serving time.
Safety precautions were okay, the male restroom was clean enough. This place is worth a visit and I'd give 3.5 stars

reviews.author: VIKASH KUMAR Roy
reviews.text:
NH7 Refuel - this is the most popular hotel /dhaba for the road runners who are going towards Airport, Nandi Hills and Adiyogi . People often take a lunch/breakfast/dinner break here and prefer this place.
This restaurant offers a wide variety of food items starting from Chinese to kebab and Punjabi dishes. Roti, daal makhani, makke ki roti sarso da saag, Patiala Lassi, Chicken Mutton everything.
Food were fantastic to taste with less oil as well. The sitting arrangement is good and comfortable and has good inside and outside ambiences as rooftop view.
Staff behaviour is awesome and very attentive. The washroom facility is good. The place is well decorated and itself worth visiting. This place has plenty of parking and food securitym.

Overall highly recommended.

reviews.author: Dinakar Raj
reviews.text:
Place looks really impressive from outside because of the design and the lighting .

We had to wait for more than one hour for a Chicken Fried rice and when it arrived could not find any chicken at all !! For the price of it, it was not worth it !!
My friend orderd Chicken Noodles and he complained that he could not find any chicken too  and so  they took it back to add some pieces !!!

Ambience is good and good info and details regarding different NHs..very creative ideas but the service was a big let down!

Can only conclude that this place is basically a glorified Dabba and nothing else. The washroom is just basic and small

Hope they improve these issues and  the place will be much more popular.

reviews.author: Noorulain Saleem
reviews.text: We visited NH7 refuel in the first week of July 2021. Firstly the place was not clean and the washroom was not in a useable condition. Secondly, chicken we ordered only half plate was marinated and we were given an option to take a different type of chicken which we did. The quality of the food was bad and the bill was incorrect. We were billed for 2 plates instead of 1. There was no use raising it as the person refused to change the bill. We had to pay extra for the food we did not order and received bad quality food. Not motivated to visit this place again.
